title: German and Dutch port industrial action
description: Sequential industrial action affected German ports and planned stoppages in Rotterdam, Amsterdam and Zeeland.
operational_impact: Vessel delay; terminal handling interruption; cargo backlog
commercial_impact: Backlogs can propagate into inland logistics and adjacent gateways.

title: Typhoon Dolphin
description: Typhoon Dolphin triggered port closures, vessel clearances, airport shutdowns, ferry suspensions and rail restrictions.
operational_impact: Port, aviation, ferry and rail closures
commercial_impact: Container, feeder, air-cargo and inland schedules disrupted.

title: Drone strike damages Zayed Port area
description: Reported retaliatory strike activity caused fire/smoke and damage in the Zayed Port area.
operational_impact: Port operations / cranes / local marine activity affected
commercial_impact: Operational resilience and UAE port-security implications.

title: Rotterdam port explosion
description: Explosion at the Port of Rotterdam caused a fatality and triggered an investigation.

title: Commercial vessel LADONNA hit at Odesa
description: A UAV strike hit LADONNA at the Port of Odesa, killing one crew member and damaging the stern.
operational_impact: Commercial vessel and port safety affected
commercial_impact: Black Sea maritime corridor, grain and insurance risk.

title: JCG foreign-vessel crew injury response
description: Japan Coast Guard coordinated response to a crew injury aboard a foreign-flagged cargo vessel.
commercial_impact: Potential voyage interruption and operational delay.

title: Fishing vessel grounded near Jawoldo
description: Incheon Coast Guard reported a fishing vessel driven onto rocks by strong current; skipper rescued.

title: MSC Elsa 3 casualty and ICG response
description: Indian Coast Guard records describe MSC Elsa 3 developing a severe list, triggering SAR, salvage coordination and pollution monitoring.
commercial_impact: Containerized cargo and coastal pollution exposure.

title: Genoa breakwater reaches new construction milestone
description: Crest-wall work began and another caisson was installed on the new breakwater.
commercial_impact: Improves future megaship access and rail-hinterland competitiveness.

title: Morebaya port commissioning begins
description: Staged commissioning of stockyards, stacker-reclaimers and shiploaders began.
commercial_impact: Moves integrated mine-rail-port export chain toward operations.
